reports.title: Diana Ritchie
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: The Trust has also established a specific working group entitled
promises.summary: establish a working group to improve recognition and response to deteriorating patients

concerns.quote: Mrs Ritchie was recovering from major surgery and on her second day post operatively was suspected of having an Ileus

there were missed opportunities to escalate Mrs [name redacted] treatment arising from raised NEWS scores where there was no report of those raised scores either to the doctors on the ward or to the critical care outreach team
the observations were not taken more regularly during the night of the 5'/6"" March when it was clear that Mrs [name redacted] ! condition was deteriorating

It was also suggested to me that the observations taken at 11 o'clock, 11.05, 11.10 and 11.15 were not in fact taken at those times but were taken later, after | the first relatively short lived loss of consciousness which occurred at around 11.15
Finally this is not the first time | have had to write a Regulation 28 Report to this Trust which involves abuse of or failure to use NEWS properly at all

links.explanation: Both reports highlight failures to act on abnormal National Early Warning Scores (NEWS) that should trigger escalation of care. The earlier case notes missing completion of scoring after a high score; the later case notes unreported raised scores that did not prompt calls to clinicians.
